method: Sequential fresh wiki creations through Special:CreateWiki; login and form preparation excluded. Provisioning completion observed every 500 ms.
timing_clock: Host monotonic duration; worker queue/start times use Docker volume file timestamps on the same host clock.
limits: Three sequential samples on the current local farm, not a load test.
Login and form preparation are excluded.
Worker completion observation includes up to 500 ms polling delay plus a Docker probe round trip.
Private readiness requires completed provisioning and anonymous API denial; no private content is exposed.
The three newly created timing fixtures remain inspectable.
